text:
harry: Starting coordinated rollout for infra-agent v1.9 (serving model v2.3). Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 23:00-03:00 UTC. Initial canary 2% in US. APAC pinned to v1.8 until capacity cleared.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: dpl-3180009999. Canary(slice=2%) in us-west1. warmup=true, preflight checks enabled. ETA canary start ~3m.

sara: quick check 11 do we have warm pool per-region and expected cold-start tail? want to avoid a cold-start surge at 25%

michael: warm pools: us-west1=10 gpus (warm), us-east1=6 gpus, eu-west1=6 gpus, apac-sin=2 gpus reserved but not enough for production ramp. cold-start tail historically ~150-300ms p95 for new hosts.

vendor-bot: Support ticket #98765 opened with infra vendor for APAC quota. Vendor ETA: ~6h.

sara: thanks. recommend hold APAC off-window. we should still validate EU before increasing US traffic to 25%.

deploybot: Canary started in us-west1 (2%). dpl-3180009999: instances=2, traffic=2%, model=v2.3. Logs: /deploys/dpl-3180009999/logs

opsbot: smoke checks kicked: /health /generate /embed. Summary: /health 200 p95=50ms, /generate p95=230ms, errors=0.08%, embed p95=130ms. KV cache warm=72% after 4m.

sre-lee: Rollback criteria (auto/manual):
- 5m sustained request error rate >1.5% OR
- p95 latency >700ms for 5m OR
- any memory OOM observed on >1 host OR
- model output regression flagged by eval CI.
If triggered: run `deploybot pause dpl-3180009999 && deploybot rollback --id dpl-3180009999 --region <region> --to v1.8` and page on-call.

harry: note: pin routing for APAC to v1.8: `routes set --region apac-sin --model v1.8 --pin --reason "quota hold"`

sara: KV cache warm is under 80% in US. keep canary for +8m and re-evaluate before EU. Also set watch for token-cost spike.

michael: scaling pre-warm issued for eu-west1 +2 GPUs: `infra scale --region eu-west1 --add 2 --for dpl-3180009999`

opsbot: EU pre-warm accepted. EU canary scheduled once US holds green for 10m.

opsbot: US 10m smoke update: p95 generate=240ms, errors=0.1%, KV warm=82%. No OOMs.

harry: green to start EU canary at 3% (use eu-west1 slice). APAC still pinned.

deploybot: EU canary started dpl-3180009999-eu slice=3%, instances=2.

opsbot: EU smoke summary: /generate p95=260ms, errors=0.25%, KV warm=68% (warming).

sara: EU KV under 80% - wait 6m. if KV warm doesn't hit 80% we'll temp-scale and re-run warm script.

michael: increased eu warm by +1 GPU (temp), command: `infra scale --region eu-west1 --add 1 --reason warmup`

opsbot: EU update 7m: p95=250ms, errors=0.18%, KV warm=84%.

sre-lee: ops note: when moving to 25% be ready to revert slice-ratchet if p95 jumps >35% vs baseline for 5m. thermal fallback: lower concurrency by 15% and reduce batch-size by 1.

harry: proceeding to staged increase: US=25%, EU=25%. APAC remains pinned to v1.8.

deploybot: Traffic increase applied. dpl-3180009999: us=25%, eu=25%, apac=0% (pinned). Monitor 20m.

opsbot: Observability reminder: run synthetic prompt suite (regression check) after 30m; post-deploy metrics saved to https://observability.redwood.ai/deploys/dpl-3180009999/metrics

sara: small blip: us-west1 host returned repeated 502s (~0.4% traffic). isolating host now.

michael: isolating/evicting host us-west1-c. routing away.

opsbot: host eviction complete. error_rate back to 0.12%.

vendor-bot: update: vendor escalated APAC quota request, new ETA ~3h (may still miss current window).

harry: decision: continue US/EU to 100% if next 20m is stable. APAC scheduled for next maintenance window and will remain pinned.

opsbot: Add alert: `alert if p95 > 500ms OR error_rate > 1% for 5m` and `alert if API cost/token > 1.4x baseline for 10m`.

sre-lee: final: if any quality regression flagged by eval pipeline, pause rollout and convene ML/product triage. Manual rollback if needed.

deploybot: Rollout status: us=100% (completed), eu=100% (completed), apac=0% (pinned to v1.8). dpl-3180009999 complete. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/dpl-3180009999/notes

harry: thanks team. I'll create a short follow-up doc and schedule APAC window tomorrow. Good job. :tada:
